request.description: Run a deterministic MuJoCo probe over valid IK configurations spanning the official radius and angle ranges. Measure zero-input static hold stability, tolerance to injected shoulder velocity, and the response to one control-interval motor impulses, recording peak distance, peak joint speed, first checked exit, and complete-hold outcome.
request.rationale: The scientific model identifies residual velocity and configuration-dependent bounded actuation as the main unresolved mechanisms separating first entry from uninterrupted completion. This probe discriminates whether the physical system is intrinsically stable at valid solutions, how little residual motion can break the 1 cm sampled hold, and where motor impulses produce the largest excursions. The result will determine whether the first learning direction should prioritize braking and regulation, geometry/branch coverage, or primarily reach acquisition.
